label: PV Device State
info:
Reads PV Device State from registers:
- 96-97: Total PV Energy (low+high)
- 108: Today PV Energy
- 109-116: MPPT1-4 Voltage/Current
- 186-189: MPPT1-4 Power

Note: PV may not be connected. Values will be 0.
